end.summary:
Riya practised examples of diversity in festivals, food, dress and regions.
They identified shared seasonal and harvest ideas across Pongal, Bihu, Lohri and Makar Sankranti.
They explained that different customs can express a common idea.
They used music and instruments as an analogy for unity in diversity.
Teach-back was not passed; no misconceptions were recorded.
end.parentNote: Riya practised comparing regional festivals, foods and clothing, then looked for shared ideas beneath the differences. They used the example of different instruments combining to make one song to explain how varied traditions can form one India; this method was a useful step toward the lesson idea. The final explanation was still incomplete, so at home, ask them to give one example of a shared value or festival idea and explain it in one sentence.
